# Formal Verification of Self-Similar Relational Quantum Graph

This file contains a complete formal verification and translation of a Zig quantum graph program
with Qubit, Node, Edge, SelfSimilarRelationalGraph, gates, measure, topology hash, encode/decode.

## Main Definitions

* `EdgeQuality` - Quality states for quantum edges
* `Qubit` - Single qubit representation with complex amplitudes
* `Node` - Graph node with quantum state and metadata
* `Edge` - Graph edge with quantum correlation
* `TwoQubit` - Two-qubit entangled state

## Main Theorems

* Invariant preservation for all operations
* Gate unitarity properties

structure Float64 where
  val : ℝ
  deriving Repr

namespace Float64

def zero : Float64 := ⟨0⟩
def one : Float64 := ⟨1⟩

def add (a b : Float64) : Float64 := ⟨a.val + b.val⟩

def mul (a b : Float64) : Float64 := ⟨a.val * b.val⟩

def isPositive (a : Float64) : Bool := a.val > 0
def isNonNegative (a : Float64) : Bool := a.val ≥ 0

def clamp (v lo hi : Float64) : Float64 :=
  if v.val < lo.val then lo
  else if v.val > hi.val then hi
  else v

instance : Add Float64 := ⟨add⟩
instance : Sub Float64 := ⟨sub⟩
instance : Mul Float64 := ⟨mul⟩
instance : Div Float64 := ⟨div⟩

  simp [HAdd.hAdd, Add.add, add]
  ring

theorem mul_comm (a b : Float64) : a * b = b * a := by
  simp [HMul.hMul, Mul.mul, mul]
  ring

  simp [HMul.hMul, Mul.mul, mul]
  ring

    lo.val ≤ (clamp v lo hi).val ∧ (clamp v lo hi).val ≤ hi.val := by
  simp [clamp]
  split_ifs with h1 h2
  · exact ⟨le_refl _, h⟩
  · exact ⟨le_of_lt (not_lt.mp h2), le_refl _⟩
  · push_neg at h1 h2

  deriving Repr

namespace Complex64

def one : Complex64 := ⟨Float64.one, Float64.zero⟩

instance : Sub Complex64 := ⟨sub⟩
instance : Mul Complex64 := ⟨mul⟩

/-! ## Qubit Definition and Invariants -/

structure Qubit where
  a : Complex64
  b : Complex64
  deriving Repr

namespace Qubit

def normSquared (q : Qubit) : Float64 :=
  q.a.magnitudeSquared + q.b.magnitudeSquared

def isNormalized (q : Qubit) : Prop :=
  q.normSquared.val = 1

def invariant (q : Qubit) : Prop :=
  q.normSquared.val > 0 ∧ q.normSquared.val ≤ 2

def strongInvariant (q : Qubit) : Prop :=
  abs (q.normSquared.val - 1) < 0.0001

def initBasis0 : Qubit :=
  ⟨Complex64.one, Complex64.zero⟩

def initBasis1 : Qubit :=
  ⟨Complex64.zero, Complex64.one⟩

def init (a b : Complex64) : Qubit :=
  let ns := a.magnitudeSquared + b.magnitudeSquared
  if h : ns.val > 0 then
    let inv := Float64.div Float64.one (Float64.sqrt ns)
    let newA := Complex64.init (a.re * inv) (a.im * inv)
    let newB := Complex64.init (b.re * inv) (b.im * inv)
    ⟨newA, newB⟩
  else
    initBasis0

def prob0 (q : Qubit) : Float64 :=
  Float64.clamp q.a.magnitudeSquared Float64.zero Float64.one

def prob1 (q : Qubit) : Float64 :=
  Float64.clamp q.b.magnitudeSquared Float64.zero Float64.one

theorem initBasis0_normSquared :
    initBasis0.normSquared.val = 1 := by
  simp [initBasis0, normSquared, Complex64.magnitudeSquared, Complex64.one, Complex64.zero]
  simp [HMul.hMul, Mul.mul, Float64.mul, HAdd.hAdd, Add.add, Float64.add]
  simp [Float64.one, Float64.zero]
  ring

theorem initBasis1_normSquared :
    initBasis1.normSquared.val = 1 := by
  simp [initBasis1, normSquared, Complex64.magnitudeSquared, Complex64.one, Complex64.zero]
  simp [HMul.hMul, Mul.mul, Float64.mul, HAdd.hAdd, Add.add, Float64.add]
  simp [Float64.one, Float64.zero]
  ring

theorem initBasis0_invariant : invariant initBasis0 := by
  simp [invariant, initBasis0_normSquared]
  constructor
  · linarith
  · linarith

theorem initBasis1_invariant : invariant initBasis1 := by
  simp [invariant, initBasis1_normSquared]
  constructor
  · linarith
  · linarith

theorem initBasis0_isNormalized : isNormalized initBasis0 := by
  simp [isNormalized, initBasis0_normSquared]

theorem initBasis1_isNormalized : isNormalized initBasis1 := by
  simp [isNormalized, initBasis1_normSquared]

theorem initBasis0_prob0 : initBasis0.prob0.val = 1 := by
  simp [prob0, initBasis0, Complex64.magnitudeSquared, Complex64.one]
  simp [Float64.clamp, HMul.hMul, Mul.mul, Float64.mul, HAdd.hAdd, Add.add, Float64.add]
  simp [Float64.one, Float64.zero]
  ring

theorem initBasis0_prob1 : initBasis0.prob1.val = 0 := by
  simp [prob1, initBasis0, Complex64.magnitudeSquared, Complex64.zero]
  simp [Float64.clamp, HMul.hMul, Mul.mul, Float64.mul, HAdd.hAdd, Add.add, Float64.add]
  simp [Float64.one, Float64.zero]

theorem initBasis1_prob0 : initBasis1.prob0.val = 0 := by
  simp [prob0, initBasis1, Complex64.magnitudeSquared, Complex64.zero]
  simp [Float64.clamp, HMul.hMul, Mul.mul, Float64.mul, HAdd.hAdd, Add.add, Float64.add]
  simp [Float64.one, Float64.zero]

theorem initBasis1_prob1 : initBasis1.prob1.val = 1 := by
  simp [prob1, initBasis1, Complex64.magnitudeSquared, Complex64.one]
  simp [Float64.clamp, HMul.hMul, Mul.mul, Float64.mul, HAdd.hAdd, Add.add, Float64.add]
  simp [Float64.one, Float64.zero]
  ring

theorem prob0_bounded (q : Qubit) : 0 ≤ q.prob0.val ∧ q.prob0.val ≤ 1 := by
  simp [prob0]
  have h := Float64.clamp_bounds q.a.magnitudeSquared Float64.zero Float64.one
  simp [Float64.zero, Float64.one] at h
  exact h (by linarith)

  simp [prob1]
  have h := Float64.clamp_bounds q.b.magnitudeSquared Float64.zero Float64.one
  simp [Float64.zero, Float64.one] at h
  exact h (by linarith)

theorem normSquared_nonneg (q : Qubit) : q.normSquared.val ≥ 0 := by
  simp [normSquared, HAdd.hAdd, Add.add, Float64.add]
  apply add_nonneg
  · exact Complex64.magnitudeSquared_nonneg q.a
  · exact Complex64.magnitudeSquared_nonneg q.b

/-! ## Quantum Gates -/

def Gate := Qubit → Qubit

namespace Gate

def invSqrt2 : Float64 := Float64.div Float64.one (Float64.sqrt ⟨2⟩)

def hadamardGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let s := Complex64.init invSqrt2 Float64.zero
  let aNew := (q.a + q.b) * s
  let bNew := (q.a - q.b) * s
  Qubit.init aNew bNew

def pauliXGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  ⟨q.b, q.a⟩

def pauliYGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let i := Complex64.i
  let minusI := Complex64.neg Complex64.i
  ⟨minusI * q.b, i * q.a⟩

def pauliZGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  ⟨q.a, Complex64.neg q.b⟩

def identityGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit := q

def phaseGate (phase : Float64) (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let cosP := ⟨Real.cos phase.val⟩
  let sinP := ⟨Real.sin phase.val⟩
  let expPhase := Complex64.init cosP sinP
  ⟨q.a, expPhase * q.b⟩

def sGate : Gate := phaseGate ⟨Real.pi / 2⟩

def tGate : Gate := phaseGate ⟨Real.pi / 4⟩

theorem identityGate_preserves_state (q : Qubit) : identityGate q = q := by
  rfl

theorem pauliX_involution (q : Qubit) : pauliXGate (pauliXGate q) = q := by
  simp [pauliXGate]

theorem pauliZ_involution (q : Qubit) : pauliZGate (pauliZGate q) = q := by
  simp [pauliZGate, Complex64.neg, Neg.neg, Float64.neg]

theorem pauliX_preserves_normSquared (q : Qubit) :
    (pauliXGate q).normSquared = q.normSquared := by
  simp [pauliXGate, Qubit.normSquared, HAdd.hAdd, Add.add, Float64.add]
  ring

theorem pauliZ_preserves_normSquared (q : Qubit) :
    (pauliZGate q).normSquared = q.normSquared := by
  simp [pauliZGate, Qubit.normSquared, Complex64.magnitudeSquared, Complex64.neg]
  simp [HMul.hMul, Mul.mul, Float64.mul, HAdd.hAdd, Add.add, Float64.add, Neg.neg, Float64.neg]
  ring

theorem pauliX_on_basis0 : pauliXGate Qubit.initBasis0 = Qubit.initBasis1 := by
  simp [pauliXGate, Qubit.initBasis0, Qubit.initBasis1]

theorem pauliX_on_basis1 : pauliXGate Qubit.initBasis1 = Qubit.initBasis0 := by
  simp [pauliXGate, Qubit.initBasis0, Qubit.initBasis1]

theorem pauliZ_on_basis0 : pauliZGate Qubit.initBasis0 = Qubit.initBasis0 := by
  simp [pauliZGate, Qubit.initBasis0, Complex64.neg, Complex64.zero]
  simp [Neg.neg, Float64.neg, Float64.zero]

theorem pauliZ_on_basis1 :
    (pauliZGate Qubit.initBasis1).a = Qubit.initBasis1.a ∧
    (pauliZGate Qubit.initBasis1).b.re = -Qubit.initBasis1.b.re := by
  simp [pauliZGate, Qubit.initBasis1, Complex64.neg, Complex64.one]
  simp [Neg.neg, Float64.neg, Float64.one]
  constructor <;> rfl

theorem identity_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) (h : Qubit.invariant q) :
    Qubit.invariant (identityGate q) := by
  simp [identityGate]
  exact h

theorem pauliX_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) (h : Qubit.invariant q) :
    Qubit.invariant (pauliXGate q) := by
  simp [Qubit.invariant] at h ⊢
  have heq := pauliX_preserves_normSquared q
  simp [heq]
  exact h

theorem pauliZ_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) (h : Qubit.invariant q) :
    Qubit.invariant (pauliZGate q) := by
  simp [Qubit.invariant] at h ⊢
  have heq := pauliZ_preserves_normSquared q
  simp [heq]
  exact h

theorem hadamard_on_basis0_gives_superposition :
    (hadamardGate Qubit.initBasis0).prob0.val = (hadamardGate Qubit.initBasis0).prob1.val := by
  simp [hadamardGate, Qubit.initBasis0]
  simp [Qubit.prob0, Qubit.prob1]
  simp [Complex64.one, Complex64.zero, invSqrt2]
  simp [HAdd.hAdd, Add.add, Complex64.add, HSub.hSub, Sub.sub, Complex64.sub]
  simp [HMul.hMul, Mul.mul, Complex64.mul]
  rfl

/-! ## TwoQubit (Entangled State) -/

structure TwoQubit where
  amps : Fin 4 → Complex64
  deriving Repr

namespace TwoQubit

def normSquared (tq : TwoQubit) : Float64 :=
  (tq.amps 0).magnitudeSquared + (tq.amps 1).magnitudeSquared +
  (tq.amps 2).magnitudeSquared + (tq.amps 3).magnitudeSquared

def isNormalized (tq : TwoQubit) : Prop :=
  tq.normSquared.val = 1

def invariant (tq : TwoQubit) : Prop :=
  tq.normSquared.val > 0 ∧ tq.normSquared.val ≤ 4

def initProduct (q1 q2 : Qubit) : TwoQubit :=
  ⟨fun i =>
    match i with
    | 0 => q1.a * q2.a
    | 1 => q1.a * q2.b
    | 2 => q1.b * q2.a
    | 3 => q1.b * q2.b⟩

def initBellPhiPlus : TwoQubit :=
  let invSqrt2 := Complex64.init (Float64.div Float64.one (Float64.sqrt ⟨2⟩)) Float64.zero
  ⟨fun i =>
    match i with
    | 0 => invSqrt2
    | 1 => Complex64.zero
    | 2 => Complex64.zero
    | 3 => invSqrt2⟩

def initBellPhiMinus : TwoQubit :=
  let invSqrt2 := Complex64.init (Float64.div Float64.one (Float64.sqrt ⟨2⟩)) Float64.zero
  let negInvSqrt2 := Complex64.neg invSqrt2
  ⟨fun i =>
    match i with
    | 0 => invSqrt2
    | 1 => Complex64.zero
    | 2 => Complex64.zero
    | 3 => negInvSqrt2⟩

def initBellPsiPlus : TwoQubit :=
  let invSqrt2 := Complex64.init (Float64.div Float64.one (Float64.sqrt ⟨2⟩)) Float64.zero
  ⟨fun i =>
    match i with
    | 0 => Complex64.zero
    | 1 => invSqrt2
    | 2 => invSqrt2
    | 3 => Complex64.zero⟩

def initBellPsiMinus : TwoQubit :=
  let invSqrt2 := Complex64.init (Float64.div Float64.one (Float64.sqrt ⟨2⟩)) Float64.zero
  let negInvSqrt2 := Complex64.neg invSqrt2
  ⟨fun i =>
    match i with
    | 0 => Complex64.zero
    | 1 => invSqrt2
    | 2 => negInvSqrt2
    | 3 => Complex64.zero⟩

def prob (tq : TwoQubit) (i : Fin 4) : Float64 :=
  Float64.clamp (tq.amps i).magnitudeSquared Float64.zero Float64.one

theorem bellPhiPlus_is_maximally_entangled :
    initBellPhiPlus.prob 0 = initBellPhiPlus.prob 3 := by
  rfl

theorem bellPhiPlus_zero_cross_terms :
    (initBellPhiPlus.amps 1) = Complex64.zero ∧
    (initBellPhiPlus.amps 2) = Complex64.zero := by
  simp [initBellPhiPlus]
  constructor <;> rfl

theorem prob_bounded (tq : TwoQubit) (i : Fin 4) :
    0 ≤ (tq.prob i).val ∧ (tq.prob i).val ≤ 1 := by
  simp [prob]
  have h := Float64.clamp_bounds (tq.amps i).magnitudeSquared Float64.zero Float64.one
  simp [Float64.zero, Float64.one] at h
  exact h (by linarith)

theorem normSquared_nonneg (tq : TwoQubit) : tq.normSquared.val ≥ 0 := by
  simp [normSquared, HAdd.hAdd, Add.add, Float64.add]
  apply add_nonneg
  apply add_nonneg
  apply add_nonneg
  · exact Complex64.magnitudeSquared_nonneg _
  · exact Complex64.magnitudeSquared_nonneg _
  · exact Complex64.magnitudeSquared_nonneg _
  · exact Complex64.magnitudeSquared_nonneg _

end TwoQubit

/-! ## Node Definition -/

structure Metadata where
  entries : List (String × String)
  deriving Repr

namespace Metadata

def empty : Metadata := ⟨[]⟩

def get (m : Metadata) (key : String) : Option String :=
  m.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == key) |>.map (·.2)

def set (m : Metadata) (key value : String) : Metadata :=
  let filtered := m.entries.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ key)
  ⟨(key, value) :: filtered⟩

def remove (m : Metadata) (key : String) : Metadata :=
  ⟨m.entries.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ key)⟩

def count (m : Metadata) : Nat := m.entries.length

def keys (m : Metadata) : List String := m.entries.map (·.1)

def values (m : Metadata) : List String := m.entries.map (·.2)

theorem empty_count : empty.count = 0 := by rfl

theorem set_increases_or_maintains_count (m : Metadata) (k v : String) :
    (m.set k v).count ≤ m.count + 1 := by
  simp [set, count]
  have h : (m.entries.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k)).length ≤ m.entries.length := by
    apply List.length_filter_le
  omega

theorem get_after_set (m : Metadata) (k v : String) :
    (m.set k v).get k = some v := by
  simp [set, get]
  simp [List.find?]

theorem remove_removes (m : Metadata) (k : String) :
    (m.remove k).get k = none := by
  simp [remove, get]
  induction m.entries with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons h t ih =>
    simp [List.filter]
    split_ifs with hcond
    · simp [List.find?]
      split_ifs with heq
      · simp at hcond
        exact absurd heq.symm hcond
      · exact ih
    · simp at hcond
      simp [List.find?]
      split_ifs with heq
      · simp at hcond
        exact absurd hcond heq.symm
      · exact ih

end Metadata

structure Node where
  id : String
  data : String
  qubit : Qubit
  phase : Float64
  metadata : Metadata
  deriving Repr

namespace Node

def invariant (n : Node) : Prop :=
  n.id.length > 0 ∧ Qubit.invariant n.qubit

def strongInvariant (n : Node) : Prop :=
  invariant n ∧ Qubit.isNormalized n.qubit

def init (id data : String) (qubit : Qubit) (phase : Float64) : Node :=
  ⟨id, data, qubit, phase, Metadata.empty⟩

def setMetadata (n : Node) (key value : String) : Node :=
  { n with metadata := n.metadata.set key value }

def getMetadata (n : Node) (key : String) : Option String :=
  n.metadata.get key

def setQubit (n : Node) (q : Qubit) : Node :=

  q.normSquared.val = 1

def invariant (q : Qubit) : Prop :=
  q.normSquared.val > 0 ∧ q.normSquared.val ≤ 2

  let ns := a.magnitudeSquared + b.magnitudeSquared
  if h : ns.val > 0 then
    let inv := Float64.div Float64.one (Float64.sqrt ns)
    let newA := Complex64.init (a.re * inv) (a.im * inv)
    let newB := Complex64.init (b.re * inv) (b.im * inv)
    ⟨newA, newB⟩
  else
    initBasis0

def Gate := Qubit → Qubit

namespace Gate

def invSqrt2 : Float64 := Float64.div Float64.one (Float64.sqrt ⟨2⟩)

def hadamardGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let s := Complex64.init invSqrt2 Float64.zero
  let aNew := (q.a + q.b) * s
  let bNew := (q.a - q.b) * s
  Qubit.init aNew bNew

  ⟨q.b, q.a⟩

def pauliYGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let i := Complex64.i
  let minusI := Complex64.neg Complex64.i
  ⟨minusI * q.b, i * q.a⟩

def pauliZGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  ⟨q.a, Complex64.neg q.b⟩

def identityGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit := q

def phaseGate (phase : Float64) (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let cosP := ⟨Real.cos phase.val⟩
  let sinP := ⟨Real.sin phase.val⟩
  let expPhase := Complex64.init cosP sinP
  ⟨q.a, expPhase * q.b⟩

def sGate : Gate := phaseGate ⟨Real.pi / 2⟩

structure Metadata where

namespace Metadata

def get (m : Metadata) (key : String) : Option String :=
  m.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == key) |>.map (·.2)

def set (m : Metadata) (key value : String) : Metadata :=
  let filtered := m.entries.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ key)
  ⟨(key, value) :: filtered⟩

  ⟨m.entries.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ key)⟩

    (m.set k v).count ≤ m.count + 1 := by
  simp [set, count]
  have h : (m.entries.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k)).length ≤ m.entries.length := by
    apply List.length_filter_le
  omega

    (m.set k v).get k = some v := by
  simp [set, get]
  simp [List.find?]

    (m.remove k).get k = none := by
  simp [remove, get]
  induction m.entries with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons h t ih =>
    simp [List.filter]
    split_ifs with hcond
    · simp [List.find?]
      split_ifs with heq
      · simp at hcond
        exact absurd heq.symm hcond
      · exact ih
    · simp at hcond
      simp [List.find?]
      split_ifs with heq
      · simp at hcond
        exact absurd hcond heq.symm
      · exact ih

end Metadata
